ValidationRule.description: When a uAssist order is changed to 'Case Ready to Review', the user must enter text for each plan
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name ="uAssist Order", ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Case Ready to Review"), ISCHANGED(uAssist_Status__c), OR( ISBLANK( Plan_1__c), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Number_of_Plans__c ,"2"), ISPICKVAL(Number_of_Plans__c ,"3")), ISBLANK( Plan_2__c )), AND(ISPICKVAL(Number_of_Plans__c ,"3"), ISBLANK( Plan_3__c )) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please include a message for the customer for each plan that you have created.
